mapper.select: SELECT pc.id AS customerId, pc.sales_user_id AS salesUserId, pc.conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, pc.name AS childName, pc.birth_date AS childBirthDate, pc.parent_customer_id AS parentCustomerId, ic.name AS parentName, ic.birth_date AS parentBirthDate FROM potential_customer pc JOIN integrated_customer ic ON ic.integrated_customer_id = pc.parent_customer_id WHERE pc.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.sales_user_id IS NOT NULL AND pc.is_active = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO daily_action_item ( sales_user_id, customer_id, conversion_status_code, trigger_type_code, priority_score, target_date ) VALUES ( #{salesUserId}, #{customerId}, #{conversionStatusCode}, #{triggerTypeCode}, #{priorityScore}, #{targetDate} )
